If you find this video useful feel free to smash the like button and subscribe with notifications to get the latest video so let's get straight into it. Firstly, head over to Fiverr and type in CANVA. Here we can see all the services people are offering related to Canva. If we take a look at this one, with 182 reviews, it says I will design anything in Canva. So let's take a look. This package includes social media posts. They designed Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and LinkedIn posts all in Canva. And charge £15 for it. They then designed Broshares and Fliars £22 and in their Premium Package they designed presentations with 10 social media posts for 37 pounds that's around 51 us dollars we can see here the type of designs they make they do posters flyers social media posts this person is actually quite versatile next to their five-star rating you can see that they have 16 orders in the queue so there's clearly demand for this service if we do some quick maths assuming all 16 orders or for the basic package 16 orders times 15 pounds and 11 pence this person is sitting on 241 pounds that's equivalent to 333 us dollars ready to collect all from just using canva and promoting your services on fiverr now if all these orders were for the premium package at 37 pounds, this person is now sitting on 604 pounds or 837 US dollars. Of course, it'll be somewhere in between but I'm just showing you what's possible and what's happening in real life. This is actual supply and demand. This isn't just a one-off either. There is another person who says they will create canva Instagram templates for a beautiful feed this person has 14 orders in the queue and look at what they are charging 45 pounds for 6 custom-made templates this person is sitting on £630, that s $880 minimum, ready to collect. They charge even more for the Premium Service in which they give you 18 Social Media Posts, that would be up to £1172 ready to be banked. You get the idea. So, what are they doing to earn this? As you can see, they are designing social media graphics for businesses to post on Instagram. This person is clearly good at what they do, which is why they have 269 five star reviews. Of course your results may vary depending on your work ethics, skills and application of skills. However, you can easily learn these skills now I'll show you exactly how to make six social media graphics in Canva just like this gig and you can sell them on Fiverr so let's head over to canva.com select instagram posts or create a new design that's 1080 by 1080 pixels. We'll just create a square post as an example. On the left hand side, we have these tabs where we can put the design together. The top one is templates where you can get hundreds of pre-made templates. The design will largely depend on what the client wants. So for this tutorial, I'll pretend a restaurant owner wants some posts to promote his or her business on Instagram there are some good templates but I'll just create one from scratch to show you how easy it is firstly, we want to chose a background image so I'll click on Photos and select a picture of some burgers normally the client will supply the images to you in which case you'd use those. Once you find one you like, if you click on it, the image will be added to the middle of the page. However, if you click and drag it to the side of the page, it will automatically make it a background. It should just snap in place. Double click the image and drag it to adjust the view. So, that looks good to me. Now, we can add some text on top of it. Click on the text tab on the left hand side and I'll select one of these pre-made font combinations. Let's have a quick look. This one has a fast food vibe to it, so I'll choose this one. You can resize it by clicking and dragging in the corners, and then double click the text to edit it. I'll just add late night much 10% off tasty Tuesday now what you might want to do is add your website URL and logo to the bottom for brand awareness it's also good encase anyone tries to steal your image I'll just copy this text and place it on the bottom. To upload your logo, click on the uploads tab here and upload the media. This will be the client's logo. For this video, I'll just add my logo, because I already have that uploaded and it's premade. Now I'll just position it on the bottom and that's basically done. We now want to make five more posts. Just click on Add Page, to create another blank page in this project. And I will go through the same process. I don't want to make this video to long so I will speed up this bit. But, as you can see it only takes about three minutes to make one page. So make six pages won't take too long at all say you took your time and made six posts in one hour that's $63 you've made in one hour if you want more detailed tutorials on canva then check out the videos linked in the description below so this is the end result I came up with, the last one is not the great I was just trying out different designs and looks and adding various elements but as you can see there are now 6 posts you an present to the client I'm sure you can come up with better designs than this your clients with also have some requests in terms of colors and the general look so you may have to adhere to some brand guidelines most of the time the clients are paying to save them time and you are providing a service to do that once you've finished making your design just click download in the top right hand corner to download the images that are being sent to them through Fiverr. Again I'm basically sharing what people are doing in the world to make money.
